why: removes 2 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: (1.21.4, re-reviewed for EpicCoreAPI#32; text brought up to the dd4b557 design) The old inherited verdict (moved to CloudRendererMixin and the AFTER_SKY GlobalSkyboxHook, same effect) was only partly true on 1.21.4, so both handlers are restored here as on 1.21.3. renderClouds HEAD: 1.21.4's lambda$addCloudsPass$6 calls DimensionSpecialEffects.renderClouds before CloudRenderer.render, so CloudRendererMixin alone missed a dimension drawing its own clouds; eca$skipOccludingClouds cancels that lambda at its renderClouds call (the clouds pass is added after addMainPass/addParticlesPass, so CloudGate.occlude is final). renderSky TAIL: 1.21.1 drew the global skybox at renderSky TAIL, before NeoForge's AFTER_SKY dispatch, and returned before TAIL when a custom renderSky drew; 1.21.4 renderLevel calls addSkyPass only when !isFoggyAt, addSkyPass adds no pass for SkyType NONE, lava/powder snow or a sky-blocking effect, and AFTER_SKY fires even after a custom renderSky. Since dd4b557 (port of 1.21.3's ae83f7b) the skybox (net.eca.mv.GlobalSkyboxHook.render, FOG_SKY fog) is drawn in one of two places: (1) on a frame with a sky pass (eca$recordSkyPass sets eca$skyPassAdded at addSkyPass's FrameGraphBuilder.addPass INVOKE; reset at renderLevel HEAD), inside the sky-pass lambda lambda$addSkyPass$12 just before ClientHooks.dispatchRenderStage (1.21.4's descriptor, with the Level argument) via eca$drawGlobalSkyboxBeforeAfterSky, with the lambda's FOG_SKY FogParameters, so other mods' AFTER_SKY content lies over it as in 1.21.1, skipped when that lambda's custom renderSky returned true (eca$recordCustomSky); (2) only on a frame with no sky pass, from a separate eca_global_skybox pass on targets.main added just before addMainPass (eca$addGlobalSkyboxPass, renderLevel's second FogParameters local), skipped when the dimension's DimensionSpecialEffects class overrides renderSky at all (the declaring class of its renderSky is neither DimensionSpecialEffects nor NeoForge's IDimensionSpecialEffectsExtension default; cached per class), since 1.21.1 asked that override first and returned before TAIL when it drew. eca$addGlobalSkyboxPass sets GlobalSkyboxHook.passOwned on every frame, so its AFTER_SKY handler stands down. Double rotation confirmed real: 1.21.4 renderLevel does matrix4fstack.mul(frustumMatrix) before building the frame graph, BufferUploader.drawWithShader uploads RenderSystem.getModelViewMatrix() (that stack) as ModelViewMat, and AFTER_SKY's getModelViewMatrix() is that same frustumMatrix, which GlobalSkyboxHook.render also put on its PoseStack -- view rotation applied twice; both places start the PoseStack from identity (vanilla's sky pass also draws with a bare PoseStack). renderEntity HEAD/RETURN and the renderLevel HEAD/RETURN handlers stay (renderLevel signature without LightTexture).
